subject: Re: PoC plan & deployment mode - Acme Corp (next steps)

Subject: PoC follow-up - deployment mode & next steps

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for taking the time today - really helpful to understand Acme's priorities. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side:

Summary of needs you flagged:
- High sustained throughput for batch inference (customer-facing search)
- Predictable latency sub-200ms for tail queries
- Data residency + strict access controls for model inputs (sensitive PII)

Deployment mode options we recommended on the call:
- Hosted API: fastest onboarding, lower ops overhead, but shared pool and less control over isolation
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pool in our cloud for predictable throughput and isolation - good middle ground for performance + speed to production
- Private VPC / on-prem: full network isolation and customer-managed infra - recommended if you require air-gapped or on-prem compliance

Proposed PoC approach (short):
- 2-week Dedicated trial (recommended) to validate latency and throughput at 50k qps simulated load peak + prefix KV cache behavior
- Success criteria: 95th percentile latency <200ms, throughput sustaining 80% of target, feature parity on model output quality with current baseline (precision@10 >= 0.82)
- Stakeholders: Jordan (product), Aisha (security/compliance), Procurement (contracting), BEN (sales), Marissa (solutions/eng)
- Timeline: kickoff early next week, trial run weeks 1-2, evaluation and decision by end of week 3

I've attached a concise PoC plan and a draft SLA for your procurement team to review. Can you confirm: a) agreed success criteria above, b) the primary test dataset and traffic shape we should use, and c) whether procurement needs an SOW or PO up front?

Happy to jump on a 30-min kickoff with your eng/security folks - propose Tue 28 or Wed 29 (PST).

Best,

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood-inference.com
Attachment: redwood-poc-plan.pdf

Ben - thanks for the summary and the plan. We're aligned overall. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Deployment mode: we lean toward Dedicated capacity for the PoC. We need predictable throughput and isolation, but we want Redwood to manage the infra (no on-prem initially). If the PoC shows that data residency or network controls aren't sufficient, we'll evaluate Private VPC next.

2) Success criteria: agree on the latency and throughput targets. For quality, we'll provide a labeled eval set; precision@10 target looks right but we'll share an internal baseline number by Monday.

3) Stakeholders and timeline: Aisha will own security sign-off; procurement contact is copied. We can do a kickoff on Tue 28 at 10am PST. Procurement will need the draft SLA and an approximate cost estimate for a 2-week Dedicated trial to get approvals.

4) Test data: we'll provide a masked subset of production queries and a 1-week traffic trace to replay. Let us know the preferred upload mechanism (S3 link or secure transfer).

Jordan

- Cost estimate: for a 2-week Dedicated trial sized to your load (we scoped during the call), estimate is ~$18k for reserved GPU capacity + support. We'll provide a line-item estimate for procurement in the next email.

- Data transfer: S3 presigned upload is easiest. You can send the link to marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com and she'll coordinate secure ingestion. Please ensure the dataset is masked as you noted.

Hi Jordan, Ben - quick note from the solutions/eng side before kickoff. High-level checklist for the Dedicated trial:

- Account/access: create a dedicated project in Redwood console; we'll provision a Dedicated GPU pool scoped to your org for the trial window
- Network & egress: if you have IP allowlists we need them by EOD Mon; otherwise we'll assume standard outbound-only egress
- Secrets & keys: we'll provide short-lived API keys tied to the trial project. If you prefer KMS/HSM injection, let us know (this may push timelines by a couple days)
- Monitoring: we will enable per-token cost & latency dashboards and share a read-only link during the trial
- Rollback & cleanup: Dedicated trial instances will be torn down automatically after trial unless you request extension

Alternative: if procurement or security requires VPC peering or customer-managed infra, we can scope a Private VPC PoC but that typically adds 2-3 weeks to setup. For the trial I recommend starting with Dedicated to hit latency/throughput goals quickly.

Marissa (solutions lead) will be on the kickoff and owns tuning during the trial. Monica (CS) will support onboarding and dashboard access.

Cheers,

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering Lead | Redwood Inference
